title: Fireball tuning file
description: The file game/tuning/drifters/fireball.json. Built on drifter-tuning.schema.json: the same default_variant, speed_ratio and entry_warning_ticks, plus the fireball's own type values, and variants that give their head width instead of width, height and hitbox. The loader works those three out: width and height are the head width (the fireball's size is its head, 91-decision-log.md, row 61), and the hitbox is the head circle plus the tail circle, built by core.drifters.fireball.fireball_hitbox (docs/contracts/systems/drifters.md, Rules, Fireball). Values from drifters/06-fireball.md (all guess): default_variant small; variants small 21 and big 32 (head width); speed_ratio 0.47; entry_warning_ticks 60 (07-drifters.md, shared); angle_degrees 35; tail_ratio 0.5. Key mapping to the GDD: head_width is the variants row's head width; angle_degrees is the angle row (from straight down, fixed for every fireball, never scaled); tail_ratio is the hitbox row's 'half the head's radius'. Loaded and checked by game/app/tuning.py at startup (docs/contracts/systems/app.md, Rules, Tuning loader). Rule this schema can't express, also enforced by the loader: default_variant is one of the variant names. Owner of the schema: architect. Contract: docs/contracts/systems/drifters.md, Rules, Fireball.

default_variant.description: The variant a placement gets when it names none (07-drifters.md, rule 10). Must be a key of variants. small.

variants.description: Named sizes (06-fireball.md, variants). A new size is a new entry here and needs no code (06, How to extend).

angle_degrees.description: Path angle from straight down, degrees. 0 is straight down; below 90 so it always falls. The same for every variant and every level. 35.

tail_ratio.description: Tail radius as a share of the head's radius. The tail touches the head from behind, along the path. 0.5.

head_width.description: Head diameter, px: the fireball's size (width and height), its head circle's diameter, and the base of its tail's size. 21 small, 32 big.
